audit.adaptation_reason: Exact78-degree and90-degree conditions with leg24 imply hypotenuse≈24.54. Replaced the inconsistent24.5 source length by the recomputed approximate length.
audit.independent_solution: In triangle RSV, R=180−90−78=12 degrees. Congruence maps R toT, so x=12.
